previous_source.database: Sowdhanya et al. (2024), Journal of Agriculture and Food Research
previous_source.food_name: Mucuna pruriens seed, compiled dry-weight ranges
previous_source.retrieval_method: Review, section 2; not a single assay
previous_source.basis: per 100 g dry weight, ranges across reports
previous_source.table_maps_to: Velvet bean seed (Mucuna pruriens), dry weight.

previous_rows.label: Crude carbohydrate (laboratory range)
previous_rows.source_note: Sowdhanya et al. (2024) compile 42.79–64.88 g per 100 g dry weight as crude carbohydrate. The review does not say whether that figure is carbohydrate by difference, nitrogen-free extract, or available carbohydrate, so it is not dietary carbohydrate.

previous_rows.label: Protein
previous_rows.source_note: Protein estimated from nitrogen in the reports compiled by Sowdhanya et al. (2024): 23–43 g per 100 g dry weight. A range across reports, not one portion.

previous_rows.label: Fat
previous_rows.source_note: Fat measured by extraction in the reports compiled by Sowdhanya et al. (2024): 4.1–14.39 g per 100 g dry weight. Not a fatty-acid profile.

previous_rows.label: Crude fibre (laboratory measure)
previous_rows.source_note: An older analytical residue, not total dietary fibre. Sowdhanya et al. (2024): 5.3–11.5 g per 100 g dry weight.

previous_rows.label: Ash
previous_rows.source_note: Mineral residue after combustion. Sowdhanya et al. (2024): 2.9–5.5 g per 100 g dry weight.

previous_rows.label: Iron
previous_rows.source_note: Sowdhanya et al. (2024), section 2: iron 0.06–0.95 mg/g, shown as 6–95 mg per 100 g.

previous_rows.label: Calcium
previous_rows.source_note: Sowdhanya et al. (2024), section 2: calcium 0.76–5.30 mg/g. Shown as 76–530 mg/100 g.

previous_rows.label: Potassium
previous_rows.source_note: Sowdhanya et al. (2024), section 2: potassium 0.13–0.19 mg/g, shown as 13–19 mg per 100 g.

previous_rows.label: Phosphorus
previous_rows.source_note: Sowdhanya et al. (2024), section 2: phosphorus 0.02 mg/g, a single figure rather than a range. Shown as 2 mg/100 g.

previous_rows.label: L-DOPA
previous_rows.notes: M. pruriens var. utilis; per 100 g seed material, weight/weight
previous_rows.source_note: Boonchoong et al. (2018), Table 3: validated HPLC measurements of M. pruriens var. utilis seeds from Thai sources, 3.54–3.70% w/w, equivalent to 3,540–3,700 mg per 100 g. This is not a cooked-bean value or a moisture-corrected dry-weight value. Higher heating reduced measured L-DOPA.

previous_rows.label: Polyphenols
previous_rows.source_note: Sowdhanya et al. (2024) name polyphenols among the seed bioactives.

previous_rows.label: Flavonoids
previous_rows.source_note: Sowdhanya et al. (2024) name flavonoids among the seed bioactives.

previous_rows.label: 9,12-Octadecadienoic acid
previous_rows.notes: Linoleic acid; not a measured fatty-acid amount
previous_rows.source_note: Sowdhanya et al. (2024) name 9,12-octadecadienoic acid among the seed bioactives. This is not a measured linoleic acid amount.

previous_rows.label: Fatty acids named
previous_rows.notes: Myristic, palmitic, stearic, oleic, linoleic, linolenic
previous_rows.source_note: Sowdhanya et al. (2024), section 2, name saturated fatty acids (myristic, palmitic, stearic) and unsaturated fatty acids (oleic, linoleic, linolenic).

previous_rows.label: Other antinutrients named
previous_rows.notes: Phytates, tannin, oxalate, hydrogen cyanide, trypsin inhibitors, saponins
previous_rows.source_note: Sowdhanya et al. (2024) name phytates, tannin, oxalate, hydrogen cyanide, and trypsin inhibitors with L-DOPA, and name phytic acid, tannins, and saponins in the conclusion.

decision: Withheld from standard nutrition panel: unrelated review ranges, undefined carbohydrate, crude fibre, unresolved minerals. Seed assay retained only as technical evidence.

primary_mineral_trace.material: Leaves: air-dried and pulverized; methods also describe methanol extraction. Not bean seed.
primary_mineral_trace.conversion: mg/g multiplied by 100 gives mg/100 g; arithmetic does not validate edible material.
primary_mineral_trace.unresolved: Other range endpoints and original review citation chain not fully verified.

amino_acids: Review values in mg/g protein cannot be treated as mg/100 g food. No conversion made.

provenance_corrections.historical_notes: The preserved source_note strings above are withdrawn extraction history, not verified analytical-method claims.
provenance_corrections.carbohydrate: Measurement definition is unresolved. An unspecified method does not establish what the carbohydrate figure excludes.
provenance_corrections.protein: Nitrogen estimation is a conventional interpretation of crude protein terminology; the methods of the individual underlying reports have not been verified here.
provenance_corrections.fat: Extraction is a conventional interpretation of crude fat terminology; individual underlying report methods have not been verified here.
provenance_corrections.ldopa: Verified primary abstract: studied Mucuna pruriens var. utilis seed samples, 3.54–3.70% w/w, HPLC. Table location and moisture basis are not established by the checked abstract. No cooked-bean or safe residual amount inferred.
